content: Compared all 15 touch #tests (119 check and setup lines) removed from verse/grid.coax with verse/sticks.coax: the same inputs, tolerances (1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3) and conditions, names only prefixed sticks_; one is stronger ('each finger keeps its own job' also asserts zoom == 0) and 9 new #tests cover the helpers, the slot edges and slop, finger 0, the 0.8 run edge, pinch moves, two-finger taps and the no-hotbar world. The pad clamp dx / sticks_hi(d, 1) equals the old if d > 1 branch, NaN included. No other #test, #forall or #assert was removed or changed; mutation: sticks.coax 207 of 207, gridwalk.coax --root-only 213 of 213. The INVARIANTS entry in 8d1ab618c0 held except for gridwalk_blur, which changed the input buffer outside the record so a record spanning a blur did not replay; fixed with a check in cf23b1331a and stated in INVARIANTS in e09bfdf114.
